subject: SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, device-name (names available, restrictions on use)
notes: A.1 item 189 (device-name: names available, restrictions on use), optional and documented-if-provided: PROVIDED - CONSOLE, SYSIN, SYSOUT, SYSERR with their input/output capabilities, as ONE table (ImplementorNames) that the SPECIAL-NAMES binder refuses every other name against (COBOL2241) and ACCEPT/DISPLAY read the capability from (COBOL0817). kb/Work PB862. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/ImplementorNames.cs#ImplementorNames (the pure-data implementor-name table moved to WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions so the front end's DISPLAY directive reads the same device-names as SPECIAL-NAMES (kb/Work PB807); ImplementorNameEntry stayed in the compiler as ImplementorNameEntry.cs) || editions 85,2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a facility that exists at every edition (the COBOL-85 nucleus, I-O, inter-program and SPECIAL-NAMES implementor-names; its arithmetic, the only arithmetic of COBOL-85, is what later editions name native).
